title: result.json
description: The envelope every step writes to its cache folder. A hand-run step commits its own result object through cache.mjs commit, or writes this shape itself, atomically and last.

version.description: The script version. A new version writes a new folder and leaves old results alone.

inputs.description: Each input file with the first 12 hex digits of its SHA-256. The cache folder is keyed on these.

params.description: The parameters the result was computed with. Different parameters write a different folder.
